note: Vestibule under repair, camera facing east: exposed brick and stone, a mason's scaffold, chequered floor and a round glass dome skylight (landmark). Left (north) wall: open door to the entrance hall and its staircase; far (east) wall: stone arch into the vaulted corridor; right (south) wall: the open front door onto the front garden. Feminine left (goo down the gutter, woman on a stone seat with cheese, fish in the crack, grandma bricklaying an arch), flatmates tugging one key at the centre, masculine right (man in a waistcoat with a little bull, gnome under a glass dome, builder hugging the foundation stone, estate agent with a mobile of houses, bear shown to a guest bed).
